## Description

# **View:** `[dbo].[Product Sales for 1997]`
> Aggregated sales data for products sold during the 1997 calendar year, organized by product category and product name.

### **Columns:**
| Ord | Name | Data Type | Description |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---|
| 1 | `CategoryName` | NVARCHAR(15) | Name of the product category to which the product belongs. Reference: Categories.CategoryName |
| 2 | `ProductName` | NVARCHAR(40) | Name of the product sold. Reference: Products.ProductName |
| 3 | `ProductSales` | MONEY | Total monetary value of sales for the product during 1997, aggregated from order details. |
